visualRegions.description: Complete bright hospital atrium linking emergency, pathology, radiology, pharmacy and operating theatre
Emergency treatment bay with reception counter, bed, privacy curtain and monitors at the far left of the hospital atrium
Glass-front pathology laboratory with microscopes, specimen trays, tubes and work benches left of the MRI room
Blue-lit radiology room with MRI gantry, scanner bed, control console and imaging equipment at the centre
Pharmacy dispensary with dense medication shelves, counter, storage drawers and rolling cart on the right
Operating theatre with surgical lights, draped table, instrument stand and anesthesia equipment at the far right
Color-coded clinical reference panels and monitor surfaces above the laboratory and imaging doors
